added.description:
Responsibilities

Sr Data & AI Developer

We are seeking a Senior Data & AI Developer to design, develop, and implement enterprise data engineering, analytics, and AI solutions. This role will build scalable data pipelines, data models, and data warehouse solutions while leveraging modern AI technologies to enable intelligent applications, business insights, and process automation.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in data engineering, SQL, cloud data platforms, and AI development, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, explore emerging technologies, and deliver practical AI proofs of concept and production-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data & Analytics

Design, develop, and support scalable Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, and AI-enabled data platforms across cloud and hybrid environments.
Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar technologies.
Develop scalable data models and integration architectures to support enterprise analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives.
Establish and implement event-driven, streaming, batch, and API-based integration patterns across enterprise systems.
Build and maintain data integration pipelines connecting ERP, CRM, PLM, MES, and other enterprise and manufacturing applications.
Implement data validation, quality controls, monitoring, and data governance practices to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and security.
Develop reusable semantic models, datasets, and governed data products to enable self-service analytics.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements, define KPIs, and deliver meaningful reporting and analytics solutions.
Optimize SQL queries, data models, and data processing performance to ensure scalable and efficient data solutions.
Evaluate emerging data and AI technologies and recommend solutions that improve business processes, drive innovation, and increase operational efficiency.

AI & Automation

Evaluate emerging data, AI, and automation technologies and recommend solutions that improve business processes, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify, assess, prioritize, and deliver AI use cases that improve productivity, decision-making, and business outcomes.
Develop and integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications and data platforms using APIs, Python, and cloud-based services.
Develop AI proofs of concept (POCs), validate business value, and transition successful solutions into production.
Design and develop AI-powered solutions using Azure OpenAI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Design and implement AI agents and agentic workflows to automate business processes and support intelligent decision-making.
Establish and implement best practices for AI security, governance, responsible AI usage, and ongoing monitoring.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
5+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, deploying, integrating, and supporting data engineering, analytics, machine learning, or AI solutions.
Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data integration pipelines across enterprise and manufacturing applications, including ERP, CRM, PLM, and MES systems.
Familiarity with manufacturing and industrial plant operations, including their unique data management, integration, and operational challenges.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with customers, vendors, IT teams, and management, and communicate technical concepts to stakeholders at all organizational levels.

Required Qualifications

Strong experience in data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and data warehouse development.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services and platforms, including Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark/PySpark, and Azure/Fabric Data Lakehouse or comparable cloud data platforms.
Experience with enterprise data platforms, APIs, message-based integrations, SQL, data pipelines, and data lake architecture.
Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure networking, private endpoints, role-based access control (RBAC), logging, monitoring, and cloud security best practices.
Experience developing AI-enabled applications using Python, machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn), Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, or related AI technologies.
Experience integrating modern cloud-based data platforms with legacy enterprise applications and systems.

Preferred Qualification

Microsoft DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate) or DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate) certification.
Additional certifications or training in Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, data engineering, or AI technologies.

added.title: Sr AI Software Engineer
added.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What we do:

You’ll join a software engineering team that builds internal AI solutions supporting teams across The Trade Desk. We use large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, custom MCP servers, and enterprise platforms like Anthropic Claude to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and reduce operational friction.

Our team also plays a key role in AI enablement across the company—supporting teams as they adopt Copilot, Claude and similar tools, designing and deploying custom AI agents, and guiding partners through their AI journey from idea to impact.

As a Senior AI Software Engineer on this team, you’ll be an end-to-end owner—collaborating closely with stakeholders, identifying opportunities, and delivering tools that make a real impact. We’re a nimble, fast-paced, and highly collaborative group that thrives on transforming the way teams operate and driving greater value across The Trade Desk.

What you'll do:

Some of the work that you will be doing to help us deliver on our mission is:

Partner with Business teams across The Trade Desk to understand Business processes, identify opportunities, scope and prioritize use cases, and define success metrics before building.
Design and build agents and agentic workflows, including background and conversational agents, that orchestrate tools, data, and business processes end to end to solve real-world problems and deliver measurable business value within enterprise guardrails.
Design and build custom MCP servers that securely expose enterprise data, APIs, and internal systems to AI agents, with well-designed tool schemas, proper authentication, least-privilege permission scoping, and observability.
Design and deploy intelligent agentic systems that integrate large language models (LLMs) with enterprise data, tools, and workflows using modern agent SDKs and orchestration frameworks.
Rapidly prototype, validate with real users, then harden the winners into supported solutions or hand them off to the owning team.
Drive adoption through training, office hours, playbooks, reusable templates, and reference implementations that other teams can self-serve from.
Drive quality and performance through automated testing, evaluation suites, monitoring, and data-driven evaluation of success criteria, user adoption, cost, and operational efficiency.
Mentor teammates and contribute to a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

Who you are:

You have a Bachelor's/Master's level degree in computer science or relevant engineering-related field or equivalent experience.
You have 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting, including 1-2+ years building LLM-powered solutions that reached real users in production.
You are proficient in Python and/or TypeScript and comfortable with additional languages such as C# or SQL.
You're excited about AI, including helping teams adopt Anthropic Claude, building agents, workflows and MCP servers, and guiding others through their AI journey.
You have hands-on experience with LLM APIs, tool use, and prompt engineering, and you've built MCP servers or equivalent function-calling integrations, or can show you'd ramp up quickly.
You have experience with enterprise identity and access, including OAuth, SSO/Entra ID, and scoping permissions so an agent can only do what the user is allowed to do.
You have experience productionizing applications and implementing CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable, scalable deployments.
You are skilled in data ingestion and transformation using APIs, ETL pipelines, and connectors, and familiar with vector databases and retrieval strategies.
You treat evaluation and safety as core engineering work, including evals, tracing, prompt-injection defenses, and cost and latency management.
You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, can run discovery sessions and demos with business partners, and thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
You are a fast learner who adapts quickly to new technologies and solves complex problems with creativity and pragmatism.

The Trade Desk does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of The Trade Desk. The Trade Desk is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. added.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC), you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high-stakes operational challenges. Operating with technical ownership, you will help to architect, build, and deploy production-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations.

You are a technical anchor; you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company-wide.

Key Responsibilities Include

End-to-End Architectural Understanding: Utilizing the full-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back-end integrations.
Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Implementing stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic.
Context & Retrieval Systems: Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture.
Runtime & Cloud Deployment: Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Evaluation Harness Design: Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge, synthetic test generation, human-in-the-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics.
Platform Codification: Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components.
Strategic Discovery & Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift.
Executive Translation: Serving as a technical engineer in the room with Directors and above, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade-offs.

What We’re Looking For...

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
Extensive hands-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones.
A strong foundation in statistics and machine learning, applied to problems such as forecasting, prioritization, or optimization.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern TypeScript/Node.js for full-stack API integration and backend orchestration.
Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval-driven development).
Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing).
Demonstrated ability to interface directly with enterprise stakeholders, translate ambiguous business requirements into technical architectures, and lead project delivery end-to-end.

Even Better If You Have

Bachelor or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field.
Experience building and scaling centralized context platforms or enterprise search engines similar to Verizon's internal enterprise context layer platforms.
Three or more years shipping production software and/or demonstrated experience deploying LLM applications, agentic workflows, or autonomous tool-calling pipelines into production.
Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders.
Prior forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top-tier technology firms or hyperscalers.
Record of turning one-off operational builds into enterprise-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents.
Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large-scale customer care operations.
Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense + sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management.
Advanced full-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, validating, and deploying machine learning models for time series forecasting and analysis, including statistical methods (ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, Prophet) and ML/deep learning approaches (gradient boosting such as XGBoost/LightGBM, LSTM, or transformer-based models).
Proficient in time series feature engineering (lags, rolling windows, seasonality, holiday and event effects), handling missing data, outliers, and structural breaks, and applying backtesting and cross-validation methods suited to temporal data.
Able to quantify forecast uncertainty with prediction intervals and scenario ranges, evaluate accuracy using metrics such as MAPE, RMSE, and MASE, and monitor deployed models for drift.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What we do:

You’ll join a software engineering team that builds internal AI solutions supporting teams across The Trade Desk. We use large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, custom MCP servers, and enterprise platforms like Anthropic Claude to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and reduce operational friction.

Our team also plays a key role in AI enablement across the company—supporting teams as they adopt Copilot, Claude and similar tools, designing and deploying custom AI agents, and guiding partners through their AI journey from idea to impact.

As a Senior AI Software Engineer on this team, you’ll be an end-to-end owner—collaborating closely with stakeholders, identifying opportunities, and delivering tools that make a real impact. We’re a nimble, fast-paced, and highly collaborative group that thrives on transforming the way teams operate and driving greater value across The Trade Desk.

What you'll do:

Some of the work that you will be doing to help us deliver on our mission is:

Partner with Business teams across The Trade Desk to understand Business processes, identify opportunities, scope and prioritize use cases, and define success metrics before building.
Design and build agents and agentic workflows, including background and conversational agents, that orchestrate tools, data, and business processes end to end to solve real-world problems and deliver measurable business value within enterprise guardrails.
Design and build custom MCP servers that securely expose enterprise data, APIs, and internal systems to AI agents, with well-designed tool schemas, proper authentication, least-privilege permission scoping, and observability.
Design and deploy intelligent agentic systems that integrate large language models (LLMs) with enterprise data, tools, and workflows using modern agent SDKs and orchestration frameworks.
Rapidly prototype, validate with real users, then harden the winners into supported solutions or hand them off to the owning team.
Drive adoption through training, office hours, playbooks, reusable templates, and reference implementations that other teams can self-serve from.
Drive quality and performance through automated testing, evaluation suites, monitoring, and data-driven evaluation of success criteria, user adoption, cost, and operational efficiency.
Mentor teammates and contribute to a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

You have a Bachelor's/Master's level degree in computer science or relevant engineering-related field or equivalent experience.
You have 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting, including 1-2+ years building LLM-powered solutions that reached real users in production.
You are proficient in Python and/or TypeScript and comfortable with additional languages such as C# or SQL.
You're excited about AI, including helping teams adopt Anthropic Claude, building agents, workflows and MCP servers, and guiding others through their AI journey.

You have experience with enterprise identity and access, including OAuth, SSO/Entra ID, and scoping permissions so an agent can only do what the user is allowed to do.

You are skilled in data ingestion and transformation using APIs, ETL pipelines, and connectors, and familiar with vector databases and retrieval strategies.

You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, can run discovery sessions and demos with business partners, and thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Req ID:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Senior Data Scientist - Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization - Remote to join our team in Philadelphia, Plano, Pennsylvania (US-PA), United States (US).

Senior Data Scientist – Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist
to lead the architecture, development, and scaling of an enterprise data harmonization platform focused on transforming large volumes of complex healthcare and medical data into standardized, structured, and actionable information.

This individual will serve as a senior technical subject matter expert, designing and implementing intelligent AI-driven pipelines to ingest, interpret, normalize, and map heterogeneous structured and unstructured datasets, including clinical, genomic, pathology, and operational data.

The role will leverage advanced Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), semantic search, and biomedical ontologies
to automate complex data mapping and schema alignment at enterprise scale.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in machine learning architecture, transformer models, distributed computing, and AI infrastructure, including optimization and deployment across specialized hardware accelerators such as NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs. They will work closely with Data Engineering, Bioinformatics, and Regulatory/Compliance teams to deliver scalable, production-ready AI and MLOps solutions.

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Data Harmonization

Define the technical architecture and roadmap for an enterprise-scale data harmonization and intelligent mapping platform.
Design and develop AI-powered pipelines to ingest, process, normalize, and map heterogeneous clinical, genomic, biomedical, and operational datasets.
Automate complex schema alignment, semantic matching, and data transformation across structured and unstructured data sources.
Establish scalable approaches for processing multi-terabyte datasets while maintaining data quality, accuracy, and performance.

LLM, NLP & AI Model Development

Architect, fine-tune, and deploy domain-specific Large Language Models, transformer architectures, and embedding models for healthcare data interpretation and semantic alignment.
Develop advanced NLP capabilities, including Named Entity Recognition (NER), entity linking, relation extraction, and clinical information extraction.
Implement semantic search and retrieval-based approaches to improve medical terminology recognition, contextual understanding, and automated data mapping.
Evaluate and optimize model performance, accuracy, inference latency, and computational efficiency.

GPU/TPU Acceleration & Distributed AI Computing

Lead the optimization and deployment of complex AI/ML workloads using specialized hardware accelerators, including NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs.
Leverage acceleration and distributed computing technologies to support high-throughput model training, fine-tuning, and inference.
Optimize transformer and NLP workloads using technologies such as CUDA, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, DeepSpeed, and vLLM.
Establish scalable infrastructure and deployment patterns to support enterprise-level AI processing requirements.

Medical Ontology & Semantic Data Mapping

Lead the development of automated mapping solutions that align diverse healthcare data sources with established biomedical vocabularies and ontologies.
Establish standardized approaches for schema mapping, terminology normalization, semantic validation, and data quality assurance.
Work with healthcare data standards and models, including OMOP CDM, FHIR, UMLS, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, and LOINC.
Develop validation frameworks and quality controls to ensure consistency, traceability, and accuracy across mapped datasets.

MLOps, Platform Engineering & Technical Leadership

Partner with Data Engineers, Bioinformaticians, and Regulatory/Compliance teams to deliver production-ready AI and data processing solutions.
Design and implement scalable MLOps pipelines supporting model deployment, monitoring, versioning, evaluation, and continuous retraining.
Establish development standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices for enterprise AI model development.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to mid-level Data Scientists and ML Engineers.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve automation, scalability, and model performance.

Required Qualifications

6–8+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, or Applied AI, with demonstrated experience developing and deploying production-grade AI/ML solutions.
3+ years of dedicated experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Informatics, or a related domain.
Strong practical understanding of healthcare data complexities, including clinical data, medical terminology, unstructured medical records, and applicable privacy requirements such as HIPAA and GDPR.
Demonstrated experience architecting and scaling AI-driven data processing, harmonization, or semantic mapping solutions.
Strong experience with advanced NLP, transformer architectures, LLMs, and embedding models.
Experience deploying and optimizing machine learning models in distributed, enterprise-scale environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering and data science teams.

Technical Skills & Expertise

AI Infrastructure & Hardware Acceleration

Advanced experience with NVIDIA GPU architectures, including A100/H100 Tensor Core GPUs, and/or Google TPUs.
Hands-on experience with CUDA, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, DeepSpeed, and/or vLLM.
Experience optimizing distributed training, model fine-tuning, and high-throughput inference workloads.

Machine Learning & Generative AI

Expert-level Python programming and strong experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face.
Experience developing, fine-tuning, and deploying domain-specific LLMs, transformer models, and embedding models.
Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and vector-based semantic search.
Strong understanding of NLP, information extraction, entity recognition, semantic similarity, and knowledge representation.

Healthcare Data Standards & Ontologies

Strong knowledge of healthcare data standards, biomedical vocabularies, and semantic data models, including:
OMOP Common Data Model (OMOP CDM)
HL7 FHIR
UMLS
SNOMED CT
RxNorm
LOINC

Experience with clinical terminology mapping, medical ontology alignment, and healthcare data normalization.

Big Data, Cloud & Distributed Computing

Experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed data processing solutions using PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent platforms.
Familiarity with AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data and AI infrastructure.
Experience processing and harmonizing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.

MLOps & Deployment

Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, model monitoring, model versioning, and automated retraining.
Strong understanding of production ML architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.

Education

added.description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Key job responsibilities

The Science Challenges Include

Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time.
Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals.
Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles.
Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies.
Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric.

A day in the life

Lead the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind
Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale
Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization
Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements
Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions
Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions

About The Team

Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability

added.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
added.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC), you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high-stakes operational challenges. Operating with technical ownership, you will help to architect, build, and deploy production-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations.

You are a technical anchor; you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company-wide.

Key Responsibilities Include

End-to-End Architectural Understanding: Utilizing the full-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back-end integrations.
Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Implementing stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic.
Context & Retrieval Systems: Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture.
Runtime & Cloud Deployment: Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Evaluation Harness Design: Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge, synthetic test generation, human-in-the-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics.
Platform Codification: Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components.
Strategic Discovery & Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift.
Executive Translation: Serving as a technical engineer in the room with Directors and above, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade-offs.

What We’re Looking For...

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
Extensive hands-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones.
A strong foundation in statistics and machine learning, applied to problems such as forecasting, prioritization, or optimization.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern TypeScript/Node.js for full-stack API integration and backend orchestration.
Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval-driven development).
Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing).
Demonstrated ability to interface directly with enterprise stakeholders, translate ambiguous business requirements into technical architectures, and lead project delivery end-to-end.

Even Better If You Have

Bachelor or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field.
Experience building and scaling centralized context platforms or enterprise search engines similar to Verizon's internal enterprise context layer platforms.
Three or more years shipping production software and/or demonstrated experience deploying LLM applications, agentic workflows, or autonomous tool-calling pipelines into production.
Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders.
Prior forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top-tier technology firms or hyperscalers.
Record of turning one-off operational builds into enterprise-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents.
Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large-scale customer care operations.
Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense + sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management.
Advanced full-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, validating, and deploying machine learning models for time series forecasting and analysis, including statistical methods (ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, Prophet) and ML/deep learning approaches (gradient boosting such as XGBoost/LightGBM, LSTM, or transformer-based models).
Proficient in time series feature engineering (lags, rolling windows, seasonality, holiday and event effects), handling missing data, outliers, and structural breaks, and applying backtesting and cross-validation methods suited to temporal data.
Able to quantify forecast uncertainty with prediction intervals and scenario ranges, evaluate accuracy using metrics such as MAPE, RMSE, and MASE, and monitor deployed models for drift.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $81,000.00 - $155,000.00.

added.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

ExtraHop is at the forefront of innovation in the cybersecurity space, delivering cutting-edge solutions to protect organizations against evolving threats. Our Network Detection and Response (NDR) products empower businesses to detect, respond to, and mitigate cyber risks in real time.

We seek a Principal Software Engineer to join our product development organization and serve as a technical anchor on our NDR platform. In this role, you will drive the architecture and execution of complex, high-impact engineering initiatives that define the future of our products. You will operate with significant autonomy, influence engineering direction across teams, and mentor engineers at multiple levels while delivering software that addresses the most sophisticated challenges in network security.

Key Responsibilities

Design, write, and maintain robust, high-performance software to deploy AI/ML models that analyze network traffic for anomalous or malicious behaviors.
Design and develop autonomous AI agent architectures and multi-agent workflows.
Collaborate with data scientists, threat researchers, and cloud teams to build high-performance services, pipelines, and tooling that accelerate ML experimentation and production workflows.
Drive engineering excellence across teams through code reviews, design reviews, and the establishment of standards, patterns, and best practices.
Lead cross-functional technical initiatives and represent engineering in conversations with senior leadership and external stakeholders.
Contribute to product strategy by bringing deep technical insight to roadmap discussions, build-vs-buy decisions, and competitive differentiation.
Lead by example. Provide technical mentorship to software engineers on the team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, optimization, and rigorous engineering discipline.

Required Qualifications

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in Principal, Lead, or Staff capacity shipping enterprise-grade software.
Expert-level programming skills in Python and Go, with an emphasis on writing production-quality, well-tested, and modular code.
Experience in machine learning, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience building or operating production AI/ML systems, including model lifecycle management, data/training pipelines, and monitoring.
Expertise in applying machine learning or data science techniques to cybersecurity use cases such as anomaly detection, behavioral analysis, or threat classification.
Advanced understanding of threat detection methodologies, intrusion prevention systems, and incident response workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

A strong fundamental understanding of network telemetry and protocols.
Prior experience working in the cybersecurity domain. Familiarity with threat actor techniques and common network attack vectors.
Familiarity with machine learning applications in cybersecurity.
Understanding of threat detection, intrusion prevention, and incident response strategies.
Deep experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure.
Deep experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes at production scale.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences at the executive level.

Compensation & Benefits:
The salary range for this role is $175,000 – $200,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

About Extrahop

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Lead with Purpose:
We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity:

Find a Way:

Innovate:

Share Success:
We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

Description

The Ads Measurement Science team in the Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) team of Amazon Ads serves a centralized role developing solutions for a multitude of performance measurement products. We create solutions which measure the comprehensive impact of advertiser's ad spend, including sales impacts both online and offline and across timescales, and provide actionable insights that enable our advertisers to optimize their media portfolios. We also own the science solutions for AI tools that unlock new insights and automate high-effort customer workflows, such as custom query and report generation based on natural language user requests. We leverage a host of scientific technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Causal Inference, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision.

As a Senior Applied Scientist on the team, you will be at the forefront of innovation, developing measurement solutions end-to-end from inception to production. You will set the technical vision and innovate on behalf of our customers. You will propose, design, analyze, and productionize models to provide novel measurement insights to our customers. You will partner with engineering to deploy these solutions into production. You will work with key stakeholders from various business teams to enable advertisers to act upon those metrics.

Lead the development of ad measurement models and solutions that address the full spectrum of an advertiser's investment, focusing on scalable and efficient methodologies.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, and business teams to define and implement measurement solutions.
Use state-of-the-art scientific technologies including Generative AI, Classical Machine Learning, Causal Inference, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision to develop state of the art models that measure the impact of ad spend across multiple platforms and timescales.
Drive experimentation and the continuous improvement of ML models through iterative development, testing, and optimization.
Translate complex scientific challenges into clear and impactful solutions for business stakeholders.
Mentor and guide junior scientists, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture.
Foster collaborations between scientists to move faster, with broader impact.
Regularly engage with the broader scientific community with presentations, publications, and patents.

You will solve real-world problems by getting and analyzing large amounts of data, generate business insights and opportunities, design simulations and experiments, and develop statistical and ML models. The team is driven by business needs, which requires collaboration with other Scientists, Engineers, and Product Managers across the advertising organization. You will prepare written and verbal presentations to share insights to audiences of varying levels of technical sophistication.

We are a team of scientists across Applied, Research, Data Science and Economist disciplines. added.title: Founding AI Engineer
added.description:
Description

Envorso Sports
is building the platform that runs a professional sports team's entire fan-facing business: ticketing, website, mobile app, and increasingly commerce, CRM, and marketing, from one system instead of six disconnected vendors.

Today, most teams run a fragmented stack: a website vendor, a ticketing provider, a separate mobile app, CRM tools, marketing automation, and game-day engagement solutions bolted together. Teams don't want to pay five vendors and contractors to stitch the data together. That creates a disconnected fan journey and leaves revenue on the table.

Our platform is live today with the Seattle Seawolves of Major League Rugby, and the league itself is now on the platform, with individual teams onboarding through the season. Ticketing, website, and mobile app are shipped and in production with paying customers. CRM, marketing automation, personalization, and revenue operations are what we build next, AI-native from the start. We want candidates to know exactly where the product stands before they join.

About the Founding Engineer Role

You'll be our first in-house engineer. This is a founding role: you'll own the fan data platform for the long term and help shape how we grow engineering, not ship one feature and move on.

The problem is simple to state. Our teams and the league sit on a large fan database: ticket transactions, web and app activity, shop purchases, and email engagement. Today almost none of it is used. One salesperson calls season-pass holders; one marketer sends a broadcast email and sees who bites. Your job is to turn that data into revenue: unify what we know about each fan across ticketing, web, app, shop, and email; decide which fans should get which offer; and deliver it through email and in-app offers or push.
Offers are concrete: a promo code for an abandoned cart, a season pass or match pass, a merch bundle, a seat upgrade. Getting the wrong offer to the wrong fan costs real money and real trust with a small, loyal fan base.

You'll build for a three-to-five-year horizon, not just this quarter. We need someone who thinks like an architect (data model, scale, failure handling, consent, cost) while still shipping something a team can use in weeks.

You'll also be the engineer closest to our customers' front offices. Part of the job is understanding how a team's revenue and marketing operations actually work, and helping decide what we build first based on impact and effort.

You'll report to Gopal Rao and work alongside our five-engineer team in Argentina as one small group. Expect real overlap-hours collaboration, and expect to take a problem, make the call, and ship without waiting on someone else.

What You'll Do

Own the fan data platform end to end: a unified fan record across ticketing, web, app, and email, designed to hold up as we grow from one team's list to a whole league's
Ship fan segmentation and a targeted offers engine that decides which fans get which offer, and delivers it by email reactivation and in-app offers or push
Build marketing ops and revenue ops driven by agentic AI: fan identity, segments, campaign builder and automation, and propensity, churn, and pricing models
Bring commerce into the fan record: shop purchases alongside tickets, so offers can cross-sell merch, passes, and seat upgrades
Build the surfaces people use, in TypeScript and Next.js on web and in our mobile app, so offers are something a marketer reviews and a fan acts on, not just an API response
Design for production from day one: consent and opt-in enforcement, no duplicate sends, failures that are visible instead of silent, and costs you can explain
Work with team front offices to understand their revenue goals, and sequence the roadmap by impact and effort
Make AI how we ship: build an AI-native product where models change the outcome for a marketer or a fan, and run an agentic development process (AI-SDLC) with coding agents, specs and tests as guardrails, and human review before anything reaches a fan
Help decide how engineering grows: how we scale with our Argentina team, what we build in-house, and who we hire next

Required Qualifications

3+ years of software engineering experience shipping production software, including a consumer-facing (B2C) product used at meaningful scale
Strong system design: you've owned the non-functional side of a system (scale, reliability, data integrity, monitoring), not just its features
Strong TypeScript, comfortable in a Next.js app and an API-service codebase. Python is a plus.
Full-stack enough to ship a feature end to end, comfortable building the web UI (React/Next.js) and, ideally, mobile UI (React Native or native iOS/Android), not just the backend
Product instinct: you can take a business problem, figure out what's worth building, and explain the trade-off to a non-technical team
Fluent with AI tools and agentic development in your daily work (coding agents, AI-assisted testing and review), and able to explain where they help and where they break
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and acting on your own judgment

Strong plus:

Marketing automation, personalization, CRM, ticketing, or commerce/payments experience (Stripe or similar)
An LLM-powered feature shipped to production users
Experience leading or mentoring engineers, including a distributed team
Founding or first-engineer experience
Revenue management, dynamic pricing, or yield optimization
E-commerce (Shopify or similar)
Propensity or churn models in production
Campaign automation platforms (Braze, Klaviyo, Iterable, or similar)

Work Authorization

Must be authorized to work in the US. No employer-sponsored visas for this role.

How We Hire

Apply through Provn by completing a short challenge and video walkthrough. If your submission clears the bar, you'll move straight to a conversation with our team. We don't wait to batch candidates. The process: a screen with Gopal, a technical interview, then a panel with engineering and product leaders.

About Treeswift

In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.

We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments.

Our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.

To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital.

We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia.

Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us.

About The Role

ML sits at the heart of Treeswift’s product translating complex sensor data into meaningful insights that drive critical decision-making for our customers. As our business grows the importance of this work only grows with it.

You will join at a critical inflection point and will lead the charge on the following priorities (amongst others):

Technical Leadership. You will be responsible for continuing to improve the quality and consistency of our models across a growing breadth of operating conditions. As the breadth of models and datasets grows you will thoughtfully introduce feedback loops and ML Ops that accelerate model improvement. You have excellent judgement on what problems require fast experimentation/validation, and where we should be focused on sustainable scalable improvement over a longer period of time.
Edge model development. Working closely with our robotics and embedded teams, you will support growing exploration of model deployment on devices for real-time use cases.
Lead and grow our team (as needed). We have an incredibly talented ML team distributed across our NYC, Philly and SF offices. You will lead the current team, identify gaps and grow the team as needed.
Collaborate closely with our Software, Robotics, Hardware and Product teams to deliver on Treeswift’s vision and business objectives.

You will report to our Head of Software Engineering. This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our Lower Manhattan, NYC office (2-3 days per week in person, currently pinned to Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

About Machine Learning At Treeswift

Machine Learning at Treeswift is the layer that translates sensor data into meaning for our end-users. At a high-level we develop three categories of model that power downstream business decisions.

Classifying a point cloud - distinguishing ground from vegetation from structures etc.
Identifying individual objects within 3D space — poles, equipment, wires, trees, etc.
Describing characteristics of individual objects. This includes everything from tree species and health, detailed wire types, pole information (height, attachments, etc.) etc.

Together this information informs critical decision-making for our customers such as:

What vegetation is a risk to utility infrastructure and how severe is that risk? What action is recommended as a result (trim, removal, etc…)?
Is ongoing asset construction deviating from the expected design and if so how? If so, is this an approved deviation or a quality issue that needs to be addressed before a downstream customer or financial impact?

added.description:
Description

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are at the forefront of cloud computing, providing services that power millions of customers worldwide. Our Threat Intelligence team plays a critical role in protecting AWS infrastructure and our customers from sophisticated threats. We are seeking an Applied Scientist to join our team and help develop AI/ML models that detect and mitigate threat activities targeting AWS services and customers.

AWS Identity Threat Detection protects every door into AWS. Our Threat Evaluation Service (TES) sits inline on the authentication and registration paths for hundreds of millions of identities — from root account sign-in to Builder ID creation to OAuth token issuance — making sub-100ms fraud decisions at thousands of requests per second across multiple regions.

As an Applied Scientist on our team, you will work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, cybersecurity, and threat intelligence. You will collaborate with security engineers, software engineers, and threat researchers to build innovative solutions that identify patterns of suspicious behavior across vast amounts of network data. Your work will directly contribute to the security posture of AWS and help protect our customers from emerging threats.

In this role, you will apply your analytical expertise to deeply understand the threat landscape affecting cloud environments. You will develop a comprehensive understanding of threat actor techniques, tactics, and procedures and translate this knowledge into effective detection models. By analyzing network signals and traffic patterns, you will help produce actionable threat intelligence that enables our engineering teams to implement robust defenses against sophisticated actors.

Your responsibilities will include designing and implementing machine learning algorithms that can process and analyze large-scale network data in real-time. You will work with diverse data sources, including network logs, API calls, and system telemetry, to identify anomalous patterns indicative of malicious activity. Through continuous refinement of your models, you will help reduce false positives while ensuring high detection rates for genuine threats.

The ideal candidate possesses mathematical and statistical foundations, with experience applying machine learning techniques to complex problems. You should have a track record of developing and deploying ML models in production environments, preferably in the security domain. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python is preferred, along with experience using common AI/ML frameworks and tools.

Beyond technical skills, you should demonstrate analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. The threat landscape is constantly evolving, requiring you to adapt your approaches and develop novel solutions to counter new traffic vectors. Your curiosity and passion for understanding adversarial behaviors will drive you to continuously improve our detection capabilities. Collaboration is key in this role, as you will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate your research into practical security solutions. Communication skills are necessary to effectively share your findings with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will participate in threat hunting exercises, contribute to post-incident analyses, and provide insights that shape our security strategy.

At AWS, we operate at massive scale, which presents unique challenges and opportunities for applied scientists in the security field. Your work will have immediate impact, helping to protect critical infrastructure that powers businesses, governments, and organizations worldwide. You will have access to advanced technologies and the resources needed to pursue innovative approaches to security problems.

Join us in our mission to build the most secure cloud platform in the world, where your expertise in AI/ML will directly contribute to protecting AWS and our customers from the most sophisticated threats.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Description

The Data Scientist will join the PREVENT pAKI project (NHLBI-funded), which uses federated and pooled machine learning on EHR data from 15 hospitals and more than 320,000 non-cardiac surgery patients. The aims are to predict postoperative acute kidney injury (pAKI) and to learn personalized prevention strategies that generalize across patient subgroups. You will work directly with the PI, a nephrologist co-investigator, and site teams at Mount Sinai, UCLA and Vanderbilt. The role will leverage and create cutting edge machine learning techniques and emphasize statistical rigor, reproducibility and scientific publication.

Ideal candidate is a Master’s graduate who will use their 2+ years of background experience in healthcare data science/analytics to successfully build cohorts of pAKI patients and develop deep learning models to predict pAKI risk in future patients. This candidate is comfortable with independently performing statistical analyses, can communicate effectively and collaborate well with project stakeholders/peers. Within 1 year, candidate will have deployed a successful deep learning model using PyTorch and be able to demonstrate performance of outcome prediction suitably for technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities

Build and curate analytic cohorts from OMOP-mapped and perioperative data warehouse sources, including AKI outcome definitions (AKIN/KDIGO) and quality checks for consistency, plausibility and missingness.
Develop and validate prediction models (gradient-boosted trees, graph neural networks) with uncertainty quantification, and report discrimination, precision-recall and calibration.
Implement and compare site-specific, pooled and federated (stacked) models across three institutions and various subgroups and implement mitigation strategies for underperforming groups.
Apply causal inference methods (causal forests, policytree) and reinforcement learning to identify sub-phenotypes and personalized prevention strategies.
Maintain version-controlled, reproducible code and documentation sufficient for external replication, and prepare code and models for public release.
Contribute to manuscripts, abstracts and presentations, and communicate methods and results clearly to clinicians and non-technical audiences.
Coordinate with site teams on data requests, local model training, and project milestones.
Stay current with federated learning, causal ML and algorithmic fairness literature and propose methodological improvements.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Operations Research, Bioinformatics, Economics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics) or equivalent practical experience.
2 years of work experience in data science, software engineering, or data analysis
Experience with at least one programming language among Scala, Python, Java, C, or C++.
Experience with database languages (e.g., SQL, NoSQL)
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
Knowledge of big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark)
Self-motivated with a demonstrated ability to work independently, and to exercise independent judgment in developing complex techniques or programs in a dynamic environment

Preferred

Experience with EHR data (OMOP preferred) and clinical prediction modeling, including calibration and external validation.
Causal inference or heterogeneous treatment effect methods (e.g., grf/policytree).
Deep learning (PyTorch, graph neural networks), federated learning, or algorithmic fairness evaluation.

The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What we do:

You’ll join a software engineering team that builds internal AI solutions supporting teams across The Trade Desk. We use large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, custom MCP servers, and enterprise platforms like Anthropic Claude to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and reduce operational friction.

Our team also plays a key role in AI enablement across the company—supporting teams as they adopt Copilot, Claude and similar tools, designing and deploying custom AI agents, and guiding partners through their AI journey from idea to impact.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer on this team, you’ll be an end-to-end owner—collaborating closely with stakeholders, identifying opportunities, and delivering tools that make a real impact. We’re a nimble, fast-paced, and highly collaborative group that thrives on transforming the way teams operate and driving greater value across The Trade Desk.

What you'll do:

Some of the work that you will be doing to help us deliver on our mission is:

Partner with Business teams across The Trade Desk to understand Business processes, identify opportunities, scope and prioritize use cases, and define success metrics before building.
Design and build agents and agentic workflows, including background and conversational agents, that orchestrate tools, data, and business processes end to end to solve real-world problems and deliver measurable business value within enterprise guardrails.
Design and build custom MCP servers that securely expose enterprise data, APIs, and internal systems to AI agents, with well-designed tool schemas, proper authentication, least-privilege permission scoping, and observability.
Design and deploy intelligent agentic systems that integrate large language models (LLMs) with enterprise data, tools, and workflows using modern agent SDKs and orchestration frameworks.
Rapidly prototype, validate with real users, then harden the winners into supported solutions or hand them off to the owning team.
Drive adoption through training, office hours, playbooks, reusable templates, and reference implementations that other teams can self-serve from.
Drive quality and performance through automated testing, evaluation suites, monitoring, and data-driven evaluation of success criteria, user adoption, cost, and operational efficiency.
Mentor teammates and contribute to a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

Who you are:

You have a Bachelor's/Master's level degree in computer science or relevant engineering-related field or equivalent experience.
You have 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting, including 1-2+ years building LLM-powered solutions that reached real users in production.
You are proficient in Python and/or TypeScript and comfortable with additional languages such as C# or SQL.
You're excited about AI, including helping teams adopt Anthropic Claude, building agents, workflows and MCP servers, and guiding others through their AI journey.
You have hands-on experience with LLM APIs, tool use, and prompt engineering, and you've built MCP servers or equivalent function-calling integrations, or can show you'd ramp up quickly.
You have experience with enterprise identity and access, including OAuth, SSO/Entra ID, and scoping permissions so an agent can only do what the user is allowed to do.
You have experience productionizing applications and implementing CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable, scalable deployments.
You are skilled in data ingestion and transformation using APIs, ETL pipelines, and connectors, and familiar with vector databases and retrieval strategies.
You treat evaluation and safety as core engineering work, including evals, tracing, prompt-injection defenses, and cost and latency management.
You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, can run discovery sessions and demos with business partners, and thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
You are a fast learner who adapts quickly to new technologies and solves complex problems with creativity and pragmatism.
